steps.title: A policy answer with a real source
steps.description: The employee asks about annual leave. The backend resolves a current policy section and returns its stable citation ID.

steps.title: Employee confirmation before submission
steps.description: The leave draft excludes Meridian Foundation Day, surfaces a simulated calendar conflict, and waits for employee confirmation.

steps.title: A separate manager decision
steps.description: After employee submission, the direct manager sees a pending request and makes a separate authorized decision.

steps.title: A confirmed human handoff
steps.description: The missing broadband rule becomes a persisted HR ticket only after the employee confirms forwarding the question and evidence.

steps.title: Aggregate HR analytics
steps.description: The HR view renders a chart from returned aggregate rows and shows the reporting period and metric definition.
